result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Create a new API project from the scaffold template.

USAGE:
    tranarc new [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    tranarc new
    tranarc new --name MyApp --company Acme
    tranarc new --name MyApp --modules consumer,webhook,hangfire

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help            Prints help information                               
    -n, --name            Project name (PascalCase, e.g. MyApp)                 
    -c, --company         Company/organization name                             
    -m, --modules         Comma-separated optional modules:                     
                          consumer,webhook,hangfire,whatsapp,payment-gateway,not
                          ifications,slack                                      
    -o, --output          Output directory (defaults to ./<name>)               
    -y, --yes             Skip confirmation prompt                              
        --skip-restore    Skip dotnet restore after generation                  
        --skip-git        Skip git init after generation
